proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10757 *rukṣa gives Punjabi rukkh and eastern rūkh tree. Simple ruk is provisionally assigned to that family; extended/nasalized rũkəḍo forms need their own suffix analysis. Exact survey form ruk is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
